jobs.title: Principal Success Manager - Strategic Accounts
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.


Who You Are

Ontic is seeking a Principal Success Manager to join our high-impact Client Success team to manage our Strategic accounts. This role is for someone passionate about building long-term client relationships, skilled in managing strategic and tactical engagements, and experienced with complex global enterprises including Fortune 500 companies.

As a Principal Success Manager, you’ll be responsible for guiding our clients through their entire lifecycle post-sale, including implementation, onboarding, product adoption, executive engagement, renewals, and expansion. You will act as a trusted advisor, challenging the status quo and delivering strategic best practices that help clients maximize the value of the Ontic platform.

This is a high-visibility role requiring strong executive presence, cross-functional collaboration, and a drive to shape both client outcomes and Ontic’s future.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Ownership & Engagement

    • Own the strategic relationship with a portfolio of high-value Fortune 500 clients

    • Serve as the main point of contact post-sale, ensuring alignment with client business objectives

    • Act as a strategic advisor and tactical partner, guiding clients through platform optimization and maturity

  • Value Realization & Adoption

    • Drive platform adoption, ensuring clients realize measurable business value

    • Proactively identify opportunities for Ontic to solve additional pain points and help clients scale their protective intelligence programs

    • Build success plans, map value drivers, and track ROI to strengthen business cases for renewal and growth

  • Strategic Guidance & Challenge

    • Lead high-level business reviews and success planning sessions with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders

    • Challenge clients thoughtfully when needed—presenting data, trends, and best practices that guide better outcomes

  • Retention & Growth

    • Forecast, manage, and own renewals, ensuring seamless continuation of service

    • Partner with Sales to identify expansion opportunities and co-create account growth strategies

    • Track account health signals and proactively mitigate risks to retention

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Serve as the voice of the client internally, influencing product roadmaps, service offerings, and strategic initiatives

    • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to ensure a coordinated approach to client satisfaction and innovation

  • Operational Excellence

    • Contribute to scaling internal systems and workflows (e.g., SFDC, JIRA, Pendo) to drive efficiency and repeatability

    • Help define and refine playbooks, onboarding frameworks, and client communication models

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or related roles supporting Fortune 500 or global enterprise clients, the last 3-4 years focused on delivery value to high profile strategic accounts

  • Proven track record of managing complex, high-touch client relationships and delivering strategic value

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders

  • Confident leading both strategic planning and hands-on tactical execution

  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and presentation skills

  • Experience in SaaS platforms, preferably with enterprise B2B or security-related solutions

  • Consultative mindset with strong business acumen and problem-solving skills

  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, JIRA, Gainsight, ChurnZero, and Pendo is a plus

  • Added bonus would be experience in the corporate security space

  • Willingness to travel up to 30%, based on business needs

Medical, Vision & Dental Benefits

401k

Generous Parental Leave policy

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.

Who You Are
We are hiring a dedicated Analytics Engineer to help build and scale the data and AI foundation of our enterprise SaaS business.

Reporting to the Sr. Director of AI & Analytics within our centralized Operations organization, this is a highly hands-on role focused on architecting scalable analytics systems and AI-enabled workflows that power decision-making across the company.

You will design the core data models, architecture, and reusable assets that serve Product, Engineering & Design — while helping redefine what an analytics function looks like in the age of AI.

This is a foundational hire with high ownership and long-term growth potential.

What You'll Do

1. Enterprise Data Modeling & Architecture

  • Design and maintain scalable dbt data models in Snowflake that serve as trusted sources of truth across the business

  • Architect data pipelines and transformation workflows using Fivetran and modern ELT practices

  • Develop durable, extensible data assets that evolve as the company scales

  • Establish modeling standards, documentation practices, and governance frameworks

  • Partner with RevOps and Finance to define and operationalize core SaaS metrics (ARR, retention, expansion, pipeline, etc.)

2. AI-Enabled Systems & Workflow Integration

  • Build data foundations that power internal AI applications and LLM-enabled workflows

  • Prototype and productionize AI-driven operational use cases

  • Integrate analytics and AI into everyday workflows using tools such as Notion, Cursor, Glean, and other emerging platforms

  • Design systems that embed data directly into operational processes — not just dashboards

3. Cross-Functional Analytics Infrastructure

  • Partner with leaders across Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Engineering to translate business needs into scalable technical systems

  • Create reusable data assets that enable activation via Hightouch and analysis via Omni

  • Ensure architecture is scalable, secure, and adaptable to evolving enterprise requirements

Our Stack

Analytics: Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Hightouch, Omni
AI & Knowledge Systems: Notion, Cursor, Glean

Experience with these tools is helpful but not required. Strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly learn new technologies matter more than prior tool exposure.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-6 years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar hands-on roles

  • Strong SQL skills and deep understanding of modern data modeling (dimensional modeling, transformations, data contracts, etc.)

  • Experience building in cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, etc.)

  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, evolving AI tooling landscape

  • Systems-level thinker who designs for scalability, extensibility, and flexibility

  • Naturally curious and energized by solving ambiguous problems

  • Pride in building clean, durable architecture — not just shipping quick fixes

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across business and technical teams

  • Nice to have: Experience with Pendo, Amplitude, Heap, or Mixpanel

Why This Role Matters

We are not building a traditional BI function.

We are building an AI-augmented analytics capability that:

  • Embeds data into operational workflows

  • Enables faster, smarter enterprise decision-making

  • Evolves as AI tooling evolves

  • Treats architecture as a strategic asset, not a back-office utility

You won’t just build dashboards — you will help shape how analytics and AI power our company over the next several years.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.

Who You Are

You are a seasoned full stack engineer who operates as a trusted technical leader across multiple teams and systems. You solve the organization's hardest technical problems, set direction on architecture and engineering practice, and multiply the effectiveness of the engineers around you through mentorship and influence, without needing formal authority to do it.

You embody Ontic’s values: Do Good Above All, Raise the Bar, Lead with Empathy, Walk the Walk, and Keep Moving.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Strategy: Define and drive technical architecture and strategy for systems that span multiple teams

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with engineering leaders, product leaders, and teams across the organization on complex, high-impact initiatives

  • Technical Leadership: Set technical direction and establish engineering best practices and standards across teams

  • Mentorship: Mentor engineers across levels, develop other technical leaders, and raise the technical bar organization-wide

  • Complex Problem Solving: Take on the organization's most challenging technical problems, particularly those spanning multiple systems or domains

  • Performance, Scalability & Security: Drive improvements to performance, scalability, and security that benefit multiple teams and systems

  • Lifecycle Ownership: Own major cross-team initiatives end-to-end, from ideation through long-term operational health

  • Innovation: Evaluate and introduce new tools, frameworks, and practices that improve engineering effectiveness across the organization

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Experience: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including at least 3 years driving technical architecture or strategy across multiple teams

  • Ability to design systems and architecture that scale across multiple teams and products

  • Strong command of CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), and DevOps workflows

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional influence, including with senior stakeholders

Backend Expertise:

  • Deep expertise with Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch, including designing high-scale, distributed data systems

  • Track record of designing RESTful APIs and backend architecture that scales across teams and products

Frontend Expertise:

  • Expert-level proficiency with JavaScript, React, and modern frontend frameworks

  • Deep experience with state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query) and frontend performance optimization at scale

  • Strong command of ES2015+, TypeScript, Webpack, Jest, Tailwind, and TDD practices

  • Deep understanding of browser rendering behavior, performance tuning, and accessibility

Mindset:

  • Strategic thinker who balances long-term architecture with pragmatic delivery

  • Enjoys mentoring and multiplying the impact of other engineers

  • Curiosity, drive to learn, and enthusiasm for raising the engineering bar organization-wide

This role is based in Austin, Texas, and requires working from the Austin office three days a week.

This role supports a FedRAMP environment and requires that work be performed within the United States by individuals authorized to work in the U.S. and who are U.S. citizens.

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.

Who You Are

You are an experienced full stack engineer who can independently design, build, and ship features spanning the frontend and backend. You take ownership of your work end-to-end, raise the technical bar for those around you, and enjoy mentoring less experienced engineers while continuing to grow your own craft.

You embody Ontic’s values: Do Good Above All, Raise the Bar, Lead with Empathy, Walk the Walk, and Keep Moving.

Responsibilities

  • Design & Development: Independently design and build scalable, reliable full stack features and services spanning backend and frontend

  • Technical Leadership: Lead technical design discussions for medium-to-large features and drive sound architectural decisions

  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers in an agile environment to scope, plan, and deliver work

  • Code Quality & Reviews: Conduct thorough code reviews and uphold high standards for performant, maintainable code across the stack

  • Mentorship: Mentor associate and mid-level engineers on technical best practices and help guide their growth

  • Performance & Reliability: Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, scalability challenges, and security concerns

  • Ownership: Own features end-to-end — from design and development through deployment and operational support

  • Technical Debt: Identify and help prioritize technical debt to support long-term maintainability

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Experience: 4–6 years of hands-on software engineering experience, with solid knowledge of both backend and frontend technologies

  • Strong algorithmic and problem-solving ability

  • Working knowledge of system design and common architectural patterns

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), and DevOps workflows

Backend Expertise:

  • Solid experience with service implementation in Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, and Elasticsearch

  • Backup restoration and recurring disaster-recovery testing against RTO/RPO.

  • Drive architecture reviews and production readiness assessments

  • Partner with security and engineering to align platform strategy with enterprise objectives

  • Experience implementing enterprise observability stacks.

  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms and dedicated workload environments.

  • Exposure to service mesh and secure east-west traffic management.

  • Exposure to AIOps is a plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn.

Role summary

The IT Support Specialist (Network, Office Buildout & Physical Security) is the hands-on, on-site IT presence for Ontic’s Pune office - focused on planning, deploying, and supporting network infrastructure, office technology, and physical security coordination to enable a smooth office launch and ongoing operations. This role partners closely with IT, Information Sec Security, DevOps, Facilities, Legal, and local vendors to execute installs, troubleshoot issues, maintain a reliable and secure office environment, and keep required physical security controls organized, documented, and audit-ready.

Schedule & location

  • On-site: Monday - Friday, 10:00am–7:00pm (may vary once the office is opened and user behaviors require a different support window)

  • Location: Ontic - Pune, India (on-site office presence required)

  • Attendance: Able to reliably commute and be in the office every workday; comfortable supporting occasional after-hours cutovers during office setup or network changes

Key responsibilities

Office IT launch & ongoing buildout operations (Pune)

  • Execute IT workstreams for the active office opening and startup phase: ongoing network optimization, equipment staging, and day-to-day IT support

  • Coordinate with local vendors and contractors for structured maintenance, expansion of rack/IDF/MDF buildouts, and ongoing ISP provisioning while validating deliverables against requirements

  • Maintain and refine the office IT operational checklist (network gear, spares inventory, labeling standards, architecture diagrams, and handover documentation)

Endpoint & on-site support

  • Provide on-site and remote end-user support and incident triage for Pune teammates (macOS/Windows), prioritizing issues that impact office productivity

  • Own tickets from intake to resolution; provide clear updates, timelines, and documentation

  • Image/provision/configure new computers for onboarding (standard builds, enrollment, application baseline, security tooling, and handoff readiness; Noida handles provisioning for remote employees)

  • Support day-to-day endpoint administration and lifecycle needs (enrollment, compliance posture, patching, refreshes, repairs, offboarding)

  • Administer and troubleshoot endpoint management tooling, including:

    • Jamf (macOS management)

    • Microsoft Intune (Windows + mobile management where applicable)

    • Jamf Security Cloud (where applicable)

  • Support Android devices (deployment, troubleshooting, basic management workflows) and Linux endpoints where needed (diagnostics, package/tooling basics, SSH, logs)

  • Work with identity/access concepts and basic administration tasks as needed (SSO, MFA, conditional access concepts, basic Active Directory users/groups/permissions troubleshooting in partnership with centralized IT)

  • Provide support for office printers and peripherals as needed

Networking, network equipment & architecture

  • Deploy, configure, and support core office networking components, including:

    • Switches, routers, firewalls/security appliances, and wireless access points

    • Network closets/racks, patch panels, cable management, labeling, and inventory

  • Own day-to-day troubleshooting for network issues (wired/wireless): DHCP/DNS, VLANs, routing, NAT, Wi‑Fi performance, authentication/captive portals, and connectivity to SaaS/VPN resources

  • Implement and maintain network segmentation and access controls in partnership with IT/InfoSec (guest vs corp networks, IoT/AV networks, least privilege)

  • Document network architecture: logical diagrams, IP plans, VLAN maps, SSIDs, port assignments, circuit details, and standard configurations

  • Participate in network change planning: maintenance windows, rollout plans, validation steps, and rollback procedures

Physical security coordination & compliance

  • Serve as the local execution owner for Pune physical security readiness and vendor oversight, coordinating access control, CCTV, visitor management, and ensuring vendors meet required standards and documentation expectations.

  • Administer the office Genetec security system.

  • Help maintain required site documentation, including building agreements, emergency response plans, site risk assessments, evacuation information, and safety evidence

  • Verify and document required safety and security controls such as fire extinguisher placement, inspection status, posted evacuation routes, and physical access procedures

  • Organize and maintain physical security evidence for audits, compliance reviews, and ongoing control validation

  • Support ongoing reviews of site access, visitor procedures, security coverage, and office technology risks

  • Identify and escalate gaps that could create operational, compliance, safety, or security risk

Security tooling & endpoint protection (day-to-day)

  • Support day-to-day administration, deployment, health checks, and basic troubleshooting for endpoint security tooling (CrowdStrike, Rapid7, Jamf, etc.)

  • Follow Ontic security policies and IT standards; help enforce them with a customer-first mindset (least privilege, MFA, device compliance, patching, phishing awareness, secure configuration)

A/V and conference room support

  • Support meeting room readiness (displays, microphones/speakers, conferencing devices) and basic troubleshooting

  • Coordinate installations and upgrades for conference room equipment with vendors where applicable

Inventory & asset coordination

  • Maintain accurate inventory for Pune office IT/network assets (network gear, spares, adapters, peripherals)

  • Coordinate receiving, staging, and shipping/returns of equipment in partnership with centralized IT

Required qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on IT support experience with a strong emphasis on networking plus strong endpoint support fundamentals

  • Strong understanding of network fundamentals: TCP/IP, subnetting, VLANs, routing, DHCP, DNS, NAT, Wi‑Fi design and troubleshooting

  • Experience deploying and supporting network equipment in an office environment (switching, wireless, firewall/security edge)

  • Ability to read/create network diagrams and maintain accurate documentation (IP plans, VLAN maps, rack layouts)

  • Proven experience executing IT work for office buildouts, expansions, or relocations (vendor coordination, installs, cutovers, validation)

  • Experience coordinating office physical security activities, vendor workstreams, or site readiness requirements

  • Ability to maintain compliance-oriented documentation and evidence for office controls, safety procedures, and audit requests

  • Solid troubleshooting skills with a structured approach (hypothesis-driven triage, packet/path reasoning, clear incident notes)

  • Strong communication skills and customer-first mindset; able to coordinate across time zones with remote teams

  • Comfort working with ticketing systems and maintaining operational discipline (updates, timelines, documentation)

  • Strong working knowledge of macOS and Windows troubleshooting and support in a business environment

  • Familiarity with MDM/endpoint management concepts (enrollment, configuration profiles/policies, compliance, patching, lifecycle)

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise Wi‑Fi planning (AP placement concepts, RF basics, capacity considerations)

  • Familiarity with security concepts and best practices for office networks (segmentation, device posture, least privilege, logging/monitoring)

  • Familiarity with physical security systems such as access control, CCTV, visitor management, or related office security platforms

  • Experience in Genetec security systems

  • Experience supporting physical security controls in compliance-oriented environments

  • Experience supporting VPN connectivity and remote access patterns

  • Familiarity with basic cloud/SaaS connectivity troubleshooting (proxy/DNS issues, SSO impacts, egress constraints)

  • Experience working with compliance-oriented environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)

  • Experience with Jamf, Intune, or equivalent endpoint management tooling (or strong ability to ramp quickly)

  • Light scripting/automation is a plus, but not a primary requirement

What success looks like

  • Pune office opens on time with stable, secure wired and wireless connectivity from day one

  • Network equipment is installed cleanly with accurate labeling, inventory, and documentation

  • Physical security systems, site safety requirements, and related controls are coordinated, documented, and ready for launch

  • Compliance evidence for Pune physical security controls is organized and available for audit or leadership review

  • Network incidents are triaged quickly with clear communication and effective escalation to centralized teams when needed

  • Meeting rooms and office tech “just work,” enabling smooth on-site collaboration

  • Vendors and installers are coordinated effectively, and changes/cutovers are executed with minimal disruption

Core behaviors

  • Hands-on, execution-oriented, and comfortable being the on-site “doer” for office/network projects

  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation habits (diagrams, port maps, IP/VLAN records, control evidence, site readiness records)

  • Calm under pressure during outages and cutovers; prioritizes safety, security, and clear communication

  • Collaborative and reliable follows through and closes loops

  • Prepare exec-level reporting on pipeline, bookings, funnel conversion, productivity, and forecast accuracy; be able to defend the numbers in the room

  • Act as an early warning system — surface risks (funnel gaps, rep underperformance, pricing friction, loss signals) before they show up in the quarter-end number

  • Partner with the CRO and CRO-org leaders to highlight business results & key trends across the organization to help the leadership team understand how we are tracking to our goals, where there is risk and where there are successes to be replicated

Pre-Sales Revenue Operations + Enablement

  • Oversee the Sales Operations, Marketing/SDR Operations, and Sales Enablement functions

  • Guide the operational cadence across all functional areas within the CRO organization; ensuring tight alignment and standardized processes, that drive predictable results

  • Own the end-to-end funnel across marketing, SDR, Sales to ensure a frictionless experience that optimizes results at each stage

  • Oversee onboarding and continuous learning pathways tailored to distinct personas: SDRs (messaging/qualification), AEs (negotiation/closing), SEs (technical deep dives), Leaders (coaching/deal progression/forecasting)

  • Act as a change agent, ensuring the operational infrastructure for each function within the CRO organization scales alongside revenue growth

  • Standardize and govern core processes: lead-to-opportunity, opportunity-to-close, renewal/expansion workflows; ensuring data integrity and consistent definitions ("pipeline," "qualified lead," "conversation rate," etc.) across Sales, Marketing, and Finance

  • Develop real-time KPI tracking, dashboards, scorecards, and standardized reporting to measure performance and provide actional business insights for the leaders

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience in Revenue Operations or Sales/CS Operations, with at least 4+ years in a senior leadership role owning a multi-function operations org

  • Mature understanding of GTM + client-facing SaaS strategies with experience translating them into system and process requirements that deliver lasting business impact

  • Comfortable being the connective tissue between the Revenue org + other GTM teams & the ability to translate fluently in both directions - with experience operationalizing impactful system and process requirements that work for both teams

  • Bias toward action — this role fixes things, not just reports on them

  • Experience working with ambiguity and laser focused on delivering results; excellent analytical and decision-making skills

  • Proven experience leveraging GTM technology & sales tools; current tech stack includes Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, Claude, ChatGPT, Clari, Outreach, Marketo

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and experience as a strategic business partner

  • Demonstrated ability to build and lead a team, not just an individual function

Who You Are

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Manager to lead Ontic’s integrations product roadmap and help transform integrations into scalable, repeatable, and monetizable platform offerings. This role will define and execute the roadmap for Ontic’s integrations ecosystem, focusing on API contracts, data models, developer experience, and GTM alignment, and ensuring that Ontic’s platform scales through a standardized, API-first, and low/no-code framework.

We’re open to hiring at the Senior or Lead level depending on experience.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own the integrations product roadmap, prioritizing by customer value, ARR impact, and scalability to ensure focus on the highest-impact connectors and platform capabilities.

 - Define and maintain API contracts, canonical data models, and integration standards that enable interoperability and consistency across Ontic’s products and external systems.

 - Partner with the Integrations Architect to evolve Ontic’s integration frameworks and marketplace, defining the end-to-end product experience from configuration to monitoring.

 - Lead competitive and technology benchmarking to ensure Ontic’s integrations platform remains best-in-class in developer experience, speed, and reliability.

 - Collaborate with Engineering, Field, and GTM teams to translate customer and market needs into product requirements, balancing technical feasibility with business value.

 - Drive alignment with GTM and Customer Success teams to ensure integrations are effectively packaged, priced, and positioned as value-driving product features.

 - Champion the developer experience (DX), simplifying integration configuration, documentation, and self-service capabilities for clients, partners, and internal teams.

 - Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve the integrations value and experience using AI-enabled workflows, agentic experiences, and conversational AI frameworks.

 - Define and track success metrics for integrations and use data to inform roadmap and investment decisions.

 - Act as the voice of the customer for integrations, ensuring Ontic’s roadmap aligns with evolving customer ecosystems and technology trends.
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience; MBA or related advanced degree is a plus.

 - 8+ years of experience in Product Management for SaaS or cloud platforms, with at least 4+ years focused on integrations, APIs, or data platforms.

 - Proven success in defining and launching API-first products, integration frameworks, or marketplaces.

 - Strong understanding of API and data model design, including REST, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.

 - Familiarity with iPaaS tools is a must; hands-on experience with Workato is highly preferred.

 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, GTM, and customer teams to bring complex integration products to market.

 - Familiarity with emerging AI technologies, including LLM-enabled tools, agentic workflows, and integration-driven automation; experience bringing AI-powered product capabilities to market is a plus.

 - Deep appreciation for developer experience, documentation, and tooling that drive self-service and adoption.

 - Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with the ability to tie product decisions to business outcomes.

 - Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to influence internal and external stakeholders.

 - Bonus: experience with integration packaging and monetization, or embedded iPaaS products (e.g., Workato Embedded).
